headline: Presentation of Summer Racial Justice Academy recommendations and requests for training follow-up on restorative practices and anti-racism.
summary: The meeting will cover recommendations from the Summer Racial Justice Academy and how BSD will act on them. It will also cover how to request follow-up on training in restorative practices and anti-racism.

plain_text:
BSD Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Committee Meeting Agenda 
Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
Sustainability Academy - Library 123 North Street 
 
 
1. Opening   
1.1 Call meeting to order  
1.2 Suspend Robert's Rules  
2. Public Comment   
3. Discussion   
3.1 Autumn Bangoura presents the recommendations of the Summer Racial Justice 
Academy. Discussion of how these are moved into action by BSD.  
3.2 Teaching and Learning office: discuss how to request follow up regarding training in 
restorative practices and anti-racism. 
1. Equity tracker items to which this pertains under Leadership and Planning: 
a. Use the principles of equity to examine teaching practices. 
b. Providing anti-bias training for all staff. 
c. Implement Anti-racist lends to evaluation plans in order to hold all 
employees accountable.  
4. Action Items   
5. Adjournment  
Burlington School District Contact 864-8474 for questions on this agenda. This agenda is available in 
alternative formats upon request. Persons with disabilities, who require assistance or special arrangements 
to participate in programs and activities of the Burlington School Board of Commissioners, are encouraged 
to contact us at 802-864-8474 (voice) or 711 (TTY) at least 72 hours in advance so that proper arrangements 
can be made.
